retrievalProfile.description: A split-composition layout featuring a large halftone portrait on the right and a vertical color-blocked sidebar on the left containing a secondary framed image and stacked condensed typography.
triggerTerms: split vertical layout with halftone portrait

recipe.visualDefinition: A graphic composition divided into a wide right section featuring a high-contrast, grainy halftone portrait and a narrow left vertical bar in a deep plum hue. The left bar contains a white-bordered inset photo and three lines of vertically stacked, condensed sans-serif text. The top of the layout features a wide, extended sans-serif nameplate that spans across both sections, anchored by a circular graphic element behind the first letter.
coreVisualRelationships: Asymmetrical split between a textured photographic field and a solid color sidebar
Contrast between wide-tracked extended headers and tight-tracked condensed body text
Repetition of the subject through a primary large-scale crop and a secondary framed inset
Geometric anchoring using a circular shape behind the initial character of the display text
coreInvariants: High-contrast halftone grain texture on all photographic elements
Vertical color-blocked sidebar occupying approximately 25% of the width
White border framing the secondary inset image

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary subject is a large-scale close-up portrait filling the right 75% of the frame; secondary subject is a smaller bust-shot inset on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The deep plum vertical sidebar acts as the structural anchor for the layout.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left circular graphic, moves across the extended nameplate, drops down the vertical sidebar to the inset photo, and finishes on the stacked text at the bottom left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with photographic texture and color blocks.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cobalt Blue (circular graphic and clothing highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-saturation photographic tones contrasted against a high-value white and a deep, saturated sidebar.

letterConstructionRules: Display text uses extreme horizontal extension with wide tracking
Secondary text uses high-waisted, narrow condensed proportions
Uniform stroke weight across both styles
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial 'C' is centered within a solid circular graphic device
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Width contrast: pairing an ultra-wide extended header with a narrow condensed sub-header.
graphicDevices: Solid circular badge behind the first letter
White rectangular frame for inset photo

preserve: Circular anchor for the first letter

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, mid-century grotesque feel of the display text
Matches the sturdy, narrow proportions of the sidebar text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a split-screen background with a deep plum vertical bar on the left (25%) and a large, high-contrast halftone black and white portrait on the right. Place a smaller, white-bordered halftone portrait inside the plum bar. Add a cobalt blue circle at the top left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main name in an extended white sans-serif across the top, starting inside the blue circle. Add three lines of stacked, condensed white sans-serif text at the bottom of the plum sidebar.

verificationChecks: Is the halftone grain visible in the portraits?
Does the top text span across the color boundary?
Is the sidebar text condensed and uppercase?
Is there a white border around the smaller inset photo?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Original artist name and song titles
postGenerationChecks: Check that the halftone texture doesn't look like modern digital noise.
Ensure the extended font is significantly wider than the condensed font.
Verify the circular graphic is perfectly aligned behind the first letter.
Confirm the plum sidebar is a solid, flat color block.
recipe.reuseFormula: Split-screen layout + Halftone Portrait + (Extended Header / Condensed Sidebar Text)
